title: System Implementation (Post-Audit Redesign)
objective: Implement all systems from Phase 2 through Phase 4 against redesigned contracts
scope: Phase 2 (targeting, attack, combat-skills, potion-regen, movement), Phase 3 (objective, party), Phase 4 (merchant strategy, merchant-skills)
why_now: Foundation complete, audit done, contracts redesigned and corrected. Implementation is the next link in the M1 chain.
current_focus: v0.1.1 review fix-up complete; merchant-skills contract next

recent_updates.summary: v0.1.1 review fix-up: 6 blockers + 7 warnings addressed per user notes. New Trade system (src/trade.js) for entity-level item/gold transfer with hunter/merchant strategies. Merchant workflow: guard-based step progression, trade_sell for delivery, gold baseline tracks hunting profit, explicit sell classification via classifyForSale(). Combat-skills: removed system-level attackTarget gate (strategies gate themselves). Potion-regen: fallback to weaker tiers only. Movement: cruise() for travel sync speed. Config: MP potion thresholds added. Party: merchant excluded from DPS calc. Stand management moved to movement exclusively. Contracts updated: combat-skills, movement, configuration, party, objective. New trade.md contract. Game-api.md: added trade_sell, trade_buy, send_item, send_gold, cruise.
next: Implement R33/R34/R37 (map POI, NPC nav, monster hunts)

recent_updates.summary: Contract alignment pass: Fixed boot.js TDZ error and ctx initialization. Added missing config fields (recoveryEnabled, restockThresholds, friendlyPlayers). Logging stats provider. World-model friendlyPlayers integration. Potion-regen await swap(). Movement fully rewritten: ±90° kite logic with can_move_to(), vector length per contract, merchant stand management, nearest-attacker selection. Party: full ctx.party shape, localStorage al_bot:party:stats read/write, complete status snapshot with potions/gold/needsResupply. Combat skills: priest (partyheal) and paladin (selfheal) strategies. Boot.js: class-specific strategy wiring. Movement contract kite signature fixed. Utility functions implemented (src/utils.js).

Phase 2 and Phase 3 implemented. Targeting system supports melee/ranged/heal strategy composition. Movement rewritten with reactive kiting for non-tanks. Potion-regen uses character.targets + ctx.world hostiles. Objective system with hunter strategy. Party system with tank identification. Boot.js rewired. combat.js deleted.

Documentation corrections: targeting strategies restructured to melee/ranged/heal composition, movement kiting redefined as reactive non-tank behavior, tank identification added to party contract, priest-specific language removed in favor of capability-based checks.

phase0_implementation.description: Scheduler, event bus, shared context — Phase 0 skeleton
phase0_implementation.notes: Implemented pre-audit. Contracts unchanged — no rework needed.

phase1_implementation.notes: Contract alignment: config added recoveryEnabled, restockThresholds, friendlyPlayers. World-model isFriendly() uses ctx.config.friendlyPlayers. Logging has setStatsProvider() for scheduler stats in snapshots.

audit_and_redesign.description: Audit existing implementation, redesign system decomposition, revise contracts
audit_and_redesign.notes: Combat decomposed into targeting + attack + combat-skills. Merchant absorbed into objective. Potion-regen and movement contracts revised.

phase2_targeting.description: Targeting system — melee/ranged/heal strategy composition, priority selection, stickiness, party dedup
phase2_targeting.notes: Implements createTargeting(ctx, strategies[]), createMeleeTargetingStrategy(), createRangedTargetingStrategy(), createHealTargetingStrategy(). Heal gated on character.heal > 0.

phase2_attack.notes: Thin executor reading ctx.targeting. Heal priority over attack. Adaptive delay.

phase2_combat_skills.description: Combat skills — class-specific skill use on independent cooldowns
phase2_combat_skills.notes: Priest (partyheal) and paladin (selfheal) MVP strategies implemented. Boot.js wires class-specific strategy based on character.ctype.

phase2_potion_regen.description: Potion/Regen — uses character.targets + world hostiles, adaptive scheduling
phase2_potion_regen.notes: Contract alignment: swap() calls now awaited. executePotion is async. Combat context from character.targets + ctx.world hostiles.

phase2_movement.description: Movement — reads ctx.objective + ctx.targeting, reactive kiting for non-tanks
phase2_movement.notes: Full contract alignment: ±90° kite logic with can_move_to() validation, vector length = speed*(delay/1000), nearest-attacker selection, merchant stand management (close before move, open after travel). Kite trigger: targets > 0 AND (!tank OR ranged). Imports utils for stand functions.

phase2_boot_wiring.description: Boot.js — all systems wired, strategy selection at boot, conditional registration
phase2_boot_wiring.notes: Fixed isMerchant TDZ error. Added ctx.party and ctx.objective initialization. Logger stats provider wired. Class-specific combat skill strategy selection. All imports updated.

phase3_objective.description: Objective system — context publisher with hunter strategy
phase3_objective.notes: Hunter strategy: idle/farm/travel/recover. Farm location resolved from G.maps. Merchant strategy deferred to Phase 4.

phase3_party.description: Party system — assembly, status publishing, CM protocol, tank identification
phase3_party.notes: Full ctx.party shape (tank, basic_dps, travelSync). Merchant writes al_bot:party:stats; all chars read. Status snapshot includes potions, emptySlots, gold, needsResupply. Imports countItem from utils.
